name: Aldric the Gaul
notes: Vicus leatherworker and metalsmith. Has outlasted five garrison rotations. Repairs things the fort fabrica will not touch.
gm_notes: Objective: keep the workshop running. Goal: remain useful enough to both Romans and Germanic traders that neither side ever has a reason to remove him. Agenda: observe everything, say nothing that was not directly asked. Secret: repaired a belt fitting last week with a concealed message cylinder slot. He describes it purely as a craftsman -- the material, tolerances, the unusual design -- and waits. He does not know what it means. He mentions it because the party asked. Do NOT have him add that it seems suspicious. He is precise, not suspicious. His leatherwork uses Germanic craft patterns -- DC 14 History identifies Suebian origin specifically. DC 15 Persuasion (Acquaintance+): he will name who brought the belt fitting. DC 12 Athletics (helping with physical work): opens him as a resource for non-military repairs.
objective: Workshop open, neutral, useful to everyone.
goal: Never be on the wrong side of any conflict.
agenda: Outlast this garrison rotation like the other five.
secret: His receipts box has blackmail material on at least three officers -- collateral for unpaid debts. He has never used it.
